title: [ingest] gc-worktrees only reaps clean, fully-merged, out-of-retention worktrees
summary: scripts/gc-worktrees.js is dry-run by default (--confirm to act), retention 24h (--retention-hours). It removes ONLY worktrees that are clean AND fully merged into main AND outside retention AND not active; anything with uncommitted changes or unmerged commits is NEEDS-ATTENTION and never reaped — durable value is merged code + recorded verdict, worktrees are ephemeral.
